assertions.name: supergolden_divides_zC_minus_q_exactly
assertions.source: numer(z_C - q) = -u*(u**3 + u - 1); divided by u^3+u-1 -> quotient -u, remainder 0 (EXACT in Q[u], not a numerical zero)

assertions.name: zD_minus_q_has_no_positive_root
assertions.source: z_D - q = -q/(q**2 + 1); numerator -q has no positive root, so the factor carrying C's threshold is nowhere zero under D

assertions.name: D_vanishing_is_the_markov_relation_not_z_minus_q
assertions.source: ((q^2+1)z - q^3) == 0 identically under D (this is markovWeightD_root), so D's det-vanishing and C's supergolden threshold have disjoint mechanisms

assertions.name: C_markov_factor_vanishes_only_at_u_eq_1
assertions.source: numer under C factors as -u*(u - 1)*(u**6 + u**5 + 2*u**4 + u**3 + u**2 + u + 1); its only positive real root is u = [1] (i.e. q = 1, the classical point), NOT the supergolden value

assertions.name: C_qz_plus_1_factor_has_no_positive_root
assertions.source: numer(q*z_C + 1) = u**3 + u**2 + 1 -- the supergolden-family conjugate cubic -- with no positive real root, so the (qz+1)^5 factor supplies no threshold on u > 0

assertions.name: zD_minus_q_at_supergolden_is_far_from_zero
assertions.source: u = 1/psi = 0.682327803828019327369483739711...; z_D - q at q = u^2 is -0.382633011901595784675..., i.e. O(0.1), not a near-vanishing. (Evaluating z_C - q here in float64 returns ~5.6e-17, the floor of that arithmetic -- which is why the verdict rests on check 1's exact division and not on this number.)

description: Settles bean qou-zf9n item 3: the supergolden threshold u^3+u-1 of prop:spectrahedral-phase-collapse is the numerator of the convention-C factor (z - q), by exact division in Q[u] with remainder 0. Under the canonical convention D that factor is -q/(q^2+1), which has no positive root, and D's identical determinant-vanishing comes from the Markov relation ((q^2+1)z - q^3) = 0 instead. The two frames' vanishings have disjoint mechanisms and C's threshold has no D-frame counterpart. Scope (a), not (b): no supergolden feature is excluded anywhere else.
